Open Beauty Facts bulk export, matched by barcode. ODbL, the same licence this dataset carries. The earlier import took the name and little else; this reads the pack fields it left behind.

Blinkit product page. The ingredient declaration, net quantity, manufacturer, marketer, country of origin and shelf life are the pack's mandated declarations under Rule 149 of the Drugs & Cosmetics Rules and the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, reproduced by the retailer. Read from the page's own labelled fields, never from its marketing copy. No price or availability is taken.

nova_group derived here, not read from a source. Computed from the ingredient list already on this record by the NOVA method (Monteiro et al.), using the marker lists Open Food Facts publishes for its own implementation. Only groups 1 and 4 are written: on a held-out half of the 4,107 records carrying an Open Food Facts NOVA value, this method reaches 96.5% precision on group 1 and 98.1% on group 4, while groups 2 and 3 could not be separated from each other above 51% and are left null.
